second_order: building Etho's face pixel by pixel
theme_note: These turns all recruit or report hands-on contributions to making the shared image; they vary from proposing the face and asking for participants to placing particular squares and pixels.

second_order: changing the plan to fit and survive
theme_note: These turns revise the image, colors, border, wording, or exact position so the work can fit the canvas and resist neighbouring claims; what varies is whether the pressure is a flag, background color, FTL, or limited control of space.

These turns claim completion and thank or congratulate contributors; they range from the first 'we did it' to describing the final mark as small, humble, and respectable and saying one did one's part.

second_order: playing and arguing over a fake Etho episode
theme_note: These codes belong together as the room's own April Fools performance and its reception, not canvas conduct; they vary from posting and falling for the fake to rating it and disputing whether it remains a joke after April 1.

second_order: finding and showing where the face is
theme_note: These turns keep the changing work findable by asking for a link, giving coordinates, announcing new space, and locating the finished mark; they vary with each relocation and with whether the audience is still building or looking back.

second_order: watching and joking about what happens to the face
theme_note: These turns narrate visible changes to the image and make jokes or mourn them; the responses vary from a quickly removed swastika to destruction, an orange tan, and a post-event call to make everything orange.

second_order: calling people to save and hold the face
theme_note: These turns mobilize help or insist on holding the existing work under pressure; they vary between urgent rescue calls, technical escalation through scripts, refusing expansion, and telling a would-be mover not to flee.

second_order: bringing r/Mindcrack's plan into the work
theme_note: Both turns carry the same neighbouring community's proposed layout into this venue so participants can act on it, once as a current plan and once as a named person's proposal.
These turns respond to threatened loss by proposing backups or another move; they vary from a spare Guude spot to another face, a shift negotiated around FTL, and a new place near Guude.

second_order: relaying Discord warnings that inactivity will lose the image
theme_note: This single code records a distinct practice that belongs with no other code: bringing warnings from unseen Discord groups back into the subreddit.
